planted.description: EF Core InMemory provider added for tests (new package, highly discouraged by Microsoft). Use the real database in Testcontainers.
The FluentAssertions 7 bridge for MSTest 4 was removed (Services.ThrowException). FA failures now show as exceptions, not assertion failures.
Tests use the real clock (DateTimeOffset.UtcNow). Use fixed times or FakeTimeProvider.
Assert.AreEqual arguments swapped (expected first). Wrong failure message (MSTEST0017).
Test of a constructor and getters. No rule is tested.
Thread.Sleep in a test. Slow and flaky; use fixed times or FakeTimeProvider.Advance.
The cancel test asserts only 'does not throw'. It does not check the outcome or the status, so it passes for any cancel result.
Loop and if/else in a test body. Use [DataRow] cases; the boundary (exactly 24 hours) is not tested.
InMemory database for a query test (no real SQL, shared name between tests). The order test does not prove the PostgreSQL behavior.
BeEquivalentTo ignores order. The test about 'newest first' passes for any order. Add WithStrictOrdering().

Obsolete parameterless Testcontainers builder hidden with #pragma, image 'postgres:latest' (not pinned), fixed port binding 5432, hard-coded localhost connection string, and a second container per class.
